title: Coordenador de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI
description:
Coordenador de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI

Light – Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brasil

Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI que será responsável por coordenar as atividades de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI, garantindo a proteção dos ativos digitais e o funcionamento estável e seguro dos ambientes corporativos e críticos da empresa de energia. Atuar como elo entre a estratégia definida pela Superintendência e a execução pelas equipes técnicas, assegurando conformidade regulatória, resiliência operacional e alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.

A nossa empresa é feita por gente. Nós já fazemos parte do seu dia. Agora, queremos que você faça parte do nosso dia a dia.

Traga a sua energia para a Light !

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Seus desafios serão:

  • Liderar a equipe de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura, promovendo integração entre processos, pessoas e tecnologia.
  • Implementar e manter políticas, normas e controles de segurança alinhados a frameworks como ISO 27001, NIST CSF, IEC 62443, LGPD e regulamentos setoriais (ANEEL, ONS).
  • Coordenar atividades de gestão de vulnerabilidades, hardening, monitoração e resposta a incidentes (TI e OT).
  • Apoiar a operação do SNOC (Security & Network Operations Center) e a interface com o CSIRT, garantindo tempos de resposta adequados a incidentes.
  • Supervisionar a gestão de identidades e acessos (IAM), controles de rede, servidores e sistemas críticos.
  • Apoiar o planejamento e a execução de projetos de infraestrutura de TI, assegurando que os requisitos de segurança estejam integrados desde o desenho.
  • Garantir continuidade operacional e planos de recuperação de desastres (BCP/DRP).
  • Promover campanhas de conscientização em segurança e boas práticas para colaboradores e fornecedores.
  • Interagir com áreas regulatórias, auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências de conformidade.
  • Reportar periodicamente à Superintendência o status da segurança, principais riscos e indicadores de desempenho.
Requisitos e qualificações

O que é necessário você ter:

  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia, Segurança da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Segurança da Informação (obrigatório).
  • Certificações valorizadas: CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, CompTIA Security+, ITIL, Azure/AWS Security, ou IEC 62443.
  • Experiência comprovada em:
  • Segurança da Informação: gestão de vulnerabilidades, SNOC, IAM, políticas, auditorias.
  • Infraestrutura de TI: administração de servidores (Windows/Linux), redes, storage, gestão de ambientes críticos.
  • Resiliência Operacional: continuidade de negócios, backup, DRP.
  • Vivência em empresas de energia ou setores críticos será diferencial.
  • Conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial aplicada à Segurança da Informação (uso de IA para detecção de ameaças, análise comportamental e automação de resposta a incidentes).
Informações adicionais

O que temos para você:

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Auxílio farmácia;
  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras;
  • Programa de treinamentos.

title: Principal Product Engineer - Americas
description:
Overview

Hi I’m Abhik, Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. We’re looking for a versatile, persistent product engineer who’s not afraid to set up reusable building blocks across the stack and advocate for the time and space to do so. At Ashby, all our engineers ship features end-to-end at a high pace. We’ll give you the room to do your best work, and you'll be our guide! If that speaks to you, read on.

What Ashby gives you in return is the best of both early and growth-stage environments. The agency and no-nonsense of a seed startup: you write product specs, make product and design decisions, and build in an almost-no-meeting culture. While also the product-market fit and scale of a growth-stage startup: tens of thousands of daily users who depend on your software and eagerly await your next feature.

We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet.

You’ve probably seen this role posted before, and it’s because we’re always expanding the team (we’re on track to double this year). We’re bubbling with ideas on how to support Talent Acquisition through software, and we’ve started the journey of building products beyond Talent Acquisition. We read every application and aim to respond to yours within 3-4 days (often sooner).

About the Role and How We Work

Our engineering culture strives to recreate the environments where we did our best work as individual contributors—where we had the ownership and agency to impact our users with creative and innovative software.

We believe in ownership and autonomy, with engineers taking end-to-end responsibility for projects. You’ll research competitors, write product specs, make wireframes, and more. Examples of how product engineers at Ashby contribute include:

  • Designed and built automated interview scheduling. This feature automates scheduling by calculating possible times from a pool of interviewers and other constraints, and then presenting these times to the candidate for selection via our responsive web app.
  • Built a generalized declarative filter architecture that allows users to create complex filters for any record with a consistent UI and compile it to SQL in our backend. Many user-facing features use it.
  • Spec’d, designed, and implemented a feature that allows users to complete signing offers entirely within Ashby.
What We’re Building

As engineers, we are used to tooling that makes us better at what we do. Scheduling a final round is an excellent example. Recruiting teams wanted to schedule candidates faster, track interviewer preparation and quality, and do it with half the headcount. TA software didn’t help. So, we built and continue to build Ashby to give TA teams the highest standard of tooling.

We want other functions and departments to be jealous of what TA teams can do with Ashby, and today they often are!

Why You Should or Shouldn’t Apply

Software engineers come in many flavors, not all of which fit our model. Here are some things to help you decide if this fits you and what you’re looking for:

  • You’re not afraid to tackle any part of a technology stack. You do what’s necessary to successfully deliver a feature, whether writing frontend or choosing new infrastructure.
  • You’ve tackled projects with a lot of product and technical ambiguity and thrive at the intersection of the two.
  • You know how to balance speed and quality. We moved with urgency, while delivering a high-quality product that encouraged customer adoption.
  • You’re ambitious and open to feedback to level up.
  • You’re an excellent collaborator and communicator and can work with stakeholders to ship products.
  • You seek to create leverage in your work through automation and abstractions.

Put another way, you shouldn’t apply if:

  • You view tech leads or principals as project managers and require sign-offs.
  • You need company-wide processes to drive your projects.
  • You only want exciting work and dislike customer issues and investigations being distributed across the team.
  • You get lost in details and prefer everything planned upfront.
  • You haven’t led or owned projects before.
  • You want to mentor many junior engineers; our team is largely senior and mentorship opportunities are limited.
Engineering Culture

Our culture is grounded in ownership and collaboration. We aim for a small, talented team that can ship high-quality software fast and maintain reasonable work hours. We focus on:

  • Minimal process with ownership over decisions normally made by product and design
  • Natural collaboration and deliberate communication
  • Investing in tools and abstractions that give us leverage
  • Building a diverse team

Minimal Process & Lots of Ownership

The best engineers deliver magical outcomes with minimal oversight while keeping stakeholders informed. We prefer engineers who own their problems end-to-end rather than rely on heavy processes.

Technology Stack

TypeScript (frontend & backend), React, GraphQL API, Node.js, Postgres, Redis. Experience with these is not required, but a love of typed languages helps. Engineers who have switched from other languages are welcome; what matters is fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly.

Benefits
  • Competitive salary and equity
  • 10-year exercise window for stock options
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Minimum of 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave
  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget
  • $100/month education budget
  • Health insurance for you and dependents (fully covered by Ashby in the US; in other countries, high-quality supplemental insurance is provided)

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Nossa matéria-prima são notícias exclusivas e de alto impacto, seja por meio de informações sintéticas, seja por meio de reportagens profundas. Cobrimos assuntos e casos difíceis, que envolvem grandes personagens da vida política e econômica nacional. Praticamos jornalismo independente e apartidário com rigor profissional, mediante investigação crítica de fatos de interesse público. Valorizamos trabalho em equipe, apuração constante junto a fontes humanas e uso avançado de ferramentas digitais e de IA para obtenção, checagem e análise de fontes documentais.

  • Monitorar pautas (plenário/turmas), ler petições, votos, ementas e acórdãos.

  • Construir e manter fontes (gabinetes, advocacia, PGR/AGU, academia, sociedade civil) com ética.
  • Produzir reportagens explicativas e investigativas com documentação sólida.

  • Usar ferramentas digitais/IA para triagem, verificação e organização de materiais.
Requisitos (obrigatórios)
  • Graduação em Jornalismo (concluída).

  • Técnicas básicas de apuração; leitura cuidadosa de documentos jurídicos.
  • Conhecimento básico do funcionamento de STF e STJ (pautas, ritos, institutos).
  • Predisposição para construir e preservar fontes com ética e responsabilidade.
  • Independência e apartidarismo; julgamento editorial equilibrado.
  • Espírito crítico, curiosidade intelectual, trabalho em equipe e abertura a feedback.

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Técnicas avançadas de reportagem e produção de exclusivas de alto impacto.
  • Pesquisa e obtenção de evidências jornalisticamente úteis (bases públicas e privadas).

title: Danielle Bibas é nomeada CEO da Pierre Fabre
description:
Com longo histórico na Avon e passagem de um ano pelo Grupo Petrópolis executiva substitui Ana Paula Magri. Danielle Bibas acaba de assumir o cargo de chief executive officer (CEO) da filial brasileira da companhia francesa Pierre Fabre, sediada no Rio de Janeiro.

Ela substitui Ana Paula Magri, que havia sido a primeira pessoa brasileira a ocupar o comando da empresa no País.

Com isso, Danielle estará à frente do negócio que, no Brasil, comercializa as marcas Eau Thermal Avène (marca francesa especializada em dermocosméticos e uma das líderes em venda na Europa), Ducray (também francesa e focada em alta ciência e medicalização) e Darrow Laboratório (marca brasileira de dermocosméticos para pele oleosa e que, segundo a empresa faz sucesso entre a GenZ e começou a ser exportada para outros países da América Latina recentemente).

Danielle trabalhou como CMO do Grupo Petrópolis de setembro de 2022 a setembro de 2023, mas antes disso teve um longo histórico na Avon.

Na companhia de beleza, onde trabalhou por 12 anos, ocupou os cargos de CMO no Brasil e vice-presidente de marketing global. Imediatamente antes da Avon, também teve um histórico de 16 anos na P&G, onde também lidou com a categoria de saúde e beleza, tendo seu último cargo por lá sido o de presidente de Health and Beauty Care, no Canadá.

Metas estabelecidas

Há dois anos, a filial brasileira da Pierre Fabre – cujo faturamento global gira em torno de € 2,8 bilhões – ocupava a 10ª posição no mapa da companhia. E a então CEO, Ana Paula, afirmava que o objetivo era que o Brasil subisse cinco posições nesse ranking, dobrando o tamanho dos negócios até 2026.

Na cidade de Areal, no Rio de Janeiro, está instalada a única fábrica da Pierre Fabre fora da França. E desde 2018 o País também abriga o Brazilian Innovation Center (BIC), focado no desenvolvimento de produtos para a população local.

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Job Description

The position

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

Key responsibilities
  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country.
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders.
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics.
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery.
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities.
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS).
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE.
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM).
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues.
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas.
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required.
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met.
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required.
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops).
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team.
  • Prepare and manage a health- & safety plan.
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project.
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management.
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments.
Your profile
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes.
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery.
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence.
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

You will interact with internal and external stakeholders to identify gaps in our frameworks, and develop new solutions to address these challenges.   • Excellent verbal and written communications to enable efficient collaboration with internal and external partners in a remote-first environment

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Prior experience working directly with DISA-STIG or CIS benchmarks, including related audit + remediation tooling (e.g. Compliance as Code)

Com mais de 70 anos no mercado, a Rodobens é um dos maiores grupos financeiros do Brasil e tem ajudado milhares de pessoas a tirarem seus planos do papel e realizarem seus sonhos, independentemente do tamanho deles.

Contando com serviços de: consórcio, empréstimo, concessionárias próprias, financiamentos, seguros, telemedicina, e-commerce pra peças de automóveis, locação de veículos pessoais e de veículos comerciais, a Rodobens tem cada vez mais colocado clientes como o centro de seus valores e prezado pela inovação e praticidade.

Narrando uma história de conquistas desde 1949, a Rodobens está sediada em São José do Rio Preto, mas possui uma unidade de negócio em São Paulo e diversas concessionárias espalhadas por todo o Brasil.

Aqui na Rodobens nós incentivamos que cada pessoa seja ela mesma. Acreditamos que diferentes visões e vivências são essenciais para o desenvolvimento da empresa e para a construção de um ambiente acolhedor.

A Rodobens respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso com a diversidade.

Saiba mais sobre a área de atuação

A Rodobens Consórcio é uma empresa com mais de 50 anos de experiência e a maior administradora independente do Brasil. Reúne tradição e pioneirismo em seu DNA: foi responsável pelo primeiro consórcio de imóveis do Brasil e formação de grupos nacionais.

Atua nos segmentos de automotores (automóveis, veículos comerciais e motos), imobiliário e serviços, com capacidade de formar grupos nacionais, apoiada em uma estrutura de mais de 2.500 pontos de venda. Desde sua fundação, é filiada à Associação Brasileira de Administradoras de Consórcios (Abac), cumprindo as exigências e determinações impostas pelo Banco Central do Brasil para atuar no setor.

Tem como visão de negócio ser inovadora, eficiente e comprometida com os ideais e anseios de seus clientes e parceiros. Oferece mais do que produtos diferenciados e os meios mais econômicos e inteligentes de aquisição de bens e serviços, oferece também uma história de solidez e uma disposição permanente para a inovação, que estão expressos em uma palavra: confiabilidade!

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

No dia a dia você irá:

  • Realizar atendimento comercial da carteira de representantes local, promovendo relacionamento, treinamentos, acompanhamento de vendas, promovendo iniciativas geradoras de venda, gestão comercial etc.;
  • Administrar carteira de clientes;
  • Apoiar na rotina comercial dos pontos de vendas;
  • Garantir a retenção de clientes e prospecção de novos pontos de vendas;
  • Auxiliar nas negociações e fechamentos de vendas
  • Focar na expansão da carteira de representantes através da nomeação de novos parceiros: prospecção, seleção, treinamento, ativação etc.

Para participar do nosso processo você precisa ter:

  • Escolaridade: Ensino superior completo;
  • Habilidades: Boa comunicação, Pro atividade, Gestão Comercial; Prospecção de novos parceiros;
  • Conhecimento obrigatório: Pacote Office intermediário, Técnicas de Negociação;
  • Veículo próprio e disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Conhecimento diferencial: Experiência comercial com vendas externas no mercado de consórcio.

Local de trabalho:

Rio de Janeiro - Norte Fluminense

Modelo de trabalho: Hibrido

Benefícios pra você!

  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Descontos especiais em produtos comercializados pela Rodobens e parceiros credenciados;
  • Cursos e treinamentos em várias competências na Universidade Rodobens
  • Seguro de vida em grupo
  • Sessões de psicoterapia
  • Tá afim de fazer o bem? Aqui na Rodobens proporcionamos oportunidades de participar em váriasações de voluntariado

De segunda a sexta-feira, 8h as 18h, com 1h de almoço.

SER O PARCEIRO DO PRÓXIMO PASSO DA SUA CARREIRA!

Com mais de 70 anos de existência, a Rodobens vem trazendo soluções financeiras para empresas e pessoas, contemplando suas necessidades de acordo com cada processo. Tem sede em São José do Rio Preto/SP, com presença em todo o território nacional, possui uma sólida cultura de inovação e tradição ao entregar às pessoas clientes, fornecedoras, colaboradoras e parceiras uma experiência completa. ????

Somos especialistas em projetos de vida e possuímos uma plataforma de serviços financeiros, alavancada em um ecossistema de varejo automotivo, que distribui produtos e serviços em mais de 3.300 pontos de venda em todo o Brasil, combinando canais físicos e digitais , próprios e de parceiros.

Nosso amplo portfólio de produtos e serviços é dividido entre os financeiros (Consórcios, Empréstimos e Financiamentos, Corretagem de Seguros e Leasing e Locação de Veículos ) e os automotivos (Veículos Novos e Usados e Serviços de Pós-Venda) . ️️

title: Interpretation Geophysicist
description:
Join to apply for the Interpretation Geophysicist role at Viridien .

Viridien ( is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

Job Summary

We are looking for passionate geoscientists to join our Interpretation Team at Viridien. In this role, you will contribute directly to Velocity Model Building (VMB) by performing seismic interpretation and providing essential geological support to Processing and VMB teams. From picking horizons to building velocity scenarios, you will work at the intersection of geology, geophysics, and advanced imaging tools, helping to transform complex seismic data into meaningful insights. Your work will play a critical role in delivering high-quality results to our clients and shaping decisions across energy and earth-data projects.

Key Responsibilities
  • Perform seismic interpretation for VMB, including horizon picking (unconformities, salt horizons, pre-salt).
  • Create local velocity scenarios.
  • Apply imaging tools, workflows, and data QC (attributes, velocities, maps).
  • Integrate geological and geophysical data for deeper insights.
  • Engage directly with clients to present results and understand their perspectives.
About The Team

You will join a diverse group of interpreters, geologists, and geophysicists who collaborate closely with Processing and VMB teams. Together, we tackle complex challenges, share knowledge, and drive innovation in seismic imaging. At Viridien, collaboration is key — you will be encouraged to bring your ideas forward and grow in a supportive environment.

Qualifications
  • Master’s or PhD in Geophysics, Geology, or related field; or equivalent professional experience in the Oil & Gas industry.
  • Solid background in seismic interpretation, exploration geology, stratigraphy, or basin analysis.
  • Strong geophysical knowledge (seismic attributes, AVO, reservoir characterization, quantitative interpretation, well data QC/processing).
  • Ability to integrate data across scales (well, seismic, potential data).
  • Good understanding of seismic imaging and prospect assessment.
  • Experience with Pre-Salt or Brazilian Equatorial Margin is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  • Effective communication and presentation skills in English.
  • Python programming is a plus.
Benefits
  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus.
  • Relocation package (when applicable).
  • Comprehensive health and dental insurance.
  • Private Pension Plan
  • Meal Voucher
  • Free breakfast and snacks at the office.
  • Shiatsu Therapy at the Office
  • TotalPass Fitness Program
  • Hybrid Work Model (up to 2 remote days per week)
  • Birthday Day Off
  • Christmas Gift Card
  • Educational Assistance and Language Learning Programs
  • Continuous training via the Learning Hub, with both technical and behavioral courses.
Our Hiring Process

At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience. We may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant due to high application volumes. Candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview, and we aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round and beyond. If you require any reasonable adjustments to participate in the application or interview stages, please contact your recruiter directly. We value diversity and are committed to equal employment opportunities for all professionals.

Seu principal objetivo é otimizar os resultados comerciais, impulsionando as vendas, garantindo a execução das estratégias de mercado, e o alinhamento de todos os times comerciais. O profissional deverá ter uma visão estratégica, orientada para a análise de mercado, desenvolvimento de novos canais e parcerias, e promover a evolução contínua das equipes sob sua gestão.RESPONSABILIDADES: • Gestão dos Canais de Vendas: Supervisionar todos os canais de vendas da empresa, garantindo que as metas de vendas sejam alcançadas em cada segmento (interno, externo, revendas, etc.).
• Planejamento Estratégico: Criar e implementar planos de ação para aumentar a performance de vendas em todos os canais, com foco na expansão e otimização dos resultados comerciais.
• Análise de Desempenho Comercial: Monitorar o desempenho de cada canal de vendas, identificando tendências, oportunidades e pontos de melhoria. Utilizar essas informações para ajustar as estratégias de vendas e maximizar a participação de mercado.
• Acompanhamento de Indicadores: Analisar e acompanhar semanalmente os relatórios de vendas, desempenho e KPIs, fazendo ajustes necessários para garantir o atingimento das metas estabelecidas.
• Desenvolvimento de Novas Parcerias: Identificar novas oportunidades de parcerias estratégicas que possam fortalecer a rede de canais de vendas e ampliar a capilaridade do mercado.
• Pesquisa de Mercado: Realizar pesquisas contínuas sobre o mercado, concorrência e tendências, com o objetivo de fornecer insights e propostas de ação para a área comercial.
• Treinamento e Desenvolvimento: Planejar e coordenar treinamentos para gerentes de vendas, supervisores e equipes comerciais, visando aprimorar as competências técnicas e comportamentais.
• Gestão de Relacionamentos: Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos sólidos com parceiros comerciais, clientes-chave e outros stakeholders, promovendo o crescimento e a fidelização.
• Suporte a Gerentes e Supervisores: Oferecer suporte contínuo aos gerentes de unidades e supervisores, fornecendo orientações, ferramentas e recursos necessários para o atingimento das metas comerciais.
• Coordenação de Projetos Comerciais: Gerenciar projetos comerciais estratégicos, desde a concepção até a execução, garantindo a implementação eficaz e os resultados esperados.
• Ajustes e Melhoria Contínua: Identificar e implementar melhorias nos processos comerciais, utilizando feedbacks de equipe, clientes e mercado para refinar as práticas de vendas e aumentar a produtividade.
• Gestão do Orçamento Comercial: Controlar e gerenciar os custos comerciais, garantindo que as ações sejam realizadas dentro do orçamento previsto e que haja uma boa alocação de recursos.
• Análise de Concorrência: Acompanhar de perto as estratégias de concorrentes e realizar ajustes nas estratégias internas para manter ou aumentar a competitividade da empresa.REQUISITOS: 1. Ensino Superior Completo. Desejável Pós Graduação ou MBA na área

title: SOC Analyst
description:
SOC Analyst

NTT DATA, Inc. invites applications for the SOC Analyst role. This position focuses on monitoring, analyzing, and responding to security incidents, and managing DNS/SIEM platforms.

Responsibilities
  • Administer, monitor, and troubleshoot the Infoblox DNS/DHCP/IPAM platform in complex and distributed environments, ensuring high availability and security of DNS services.
  • Configure and maintain DNS zones, records, and security policies to protect against spoofing, tunneling, and exfiltration.
  • Operate SIEM solutions (Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar, XSIEM) – create, adjust, and validate correlation rules and use them for threat hunting.
  • Investigate, analyze, and respond to security incidents in real time, correlating events from network, endpoint, and cloud sources.
  • Escalate and coordinate critical incidents with internal teams and global clients, ensuring thorough documentation and timely resolution.
  • Ensure adherence to ITSM processes using ServiceNow, including incident categorization, investigation, and closure.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of security use cases, correlation rules, and dashboards.
Technical Requirements
  • Proven experience with Infoblox solutions and advanced DNS troubleshooting.
  • Hands‑on knowledge of multi‑vendor SIEM platforms and rule development.
  • Previous SOC experience in high‑volume environments, following ITIL/ISO 27001 practices.
  • ServiceNow ITSM experience for incident, problem, and change management.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to work in multicultural teams.
  • Analytical mindset, prioritization capability, and proactive improvement culture.
Certifications & Education
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field.
  • Security certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CEH, Splunk Certified, Sentinel, QRadar, ISO 27001.
  • Infoblox specific training (DDI, Core Network Services, Security Ecosystem Integration).
  • Experience with DNSSEC, Cisco Umbrella, Python, PowerShell, Ansible, MITRE ATT&CK, NIST frameworks.
Experience
  • Minimum 6 years in cybersecurity, with extensive monitoring, incident response, and Infoblox administration.
  • Demonstrated SOC experience in large enterprises with structured processes and high event volumes.
  • Deep familiarity with Infoblox DDI, multi‑vendor SIEM, and ITSM ServiceNow.
Important Highlights
  • Hybrid remote work available in São Paulo/SP.
  • Contractual model: CLT.
  • Equipment, transport allowance, meal voucher, and home‑office support.
  • Health & dental plan, group life insurance, PLR, pension fund, maternity leave, and annual bonuses.
  • Alumni and educational incentives, and participation in social initiatives.
  • Intermediary English required; Spanish a plus.

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
Overview

Tudo o que fazemos é por acreditar que existe um grande potencial não explorado em cada ser humano. Nosso propósito é transformar a vida das pessoas ao descobrir sua melhor versão. Somos o melhor curso de comunicação e oratória do Brasil; ajudamos pessoas e empresas a melhorarem suas performances e resultados através de uma metodologia única e inovadora que combina técnicas de oratória, fonoaudiologia, neurociência, psicologia positiva e técnicas teatrais.

Nossa cultura: No nosso dia a dia, nos propomos a fazer diferente na vida dos nossos clientes e colaboradores de forma única e eficiente, porque acreditamos que cada ser humano é único e tem grande potencial a ser descoberto e desenvolvido. Isso se tangibiliza em atitudes práticas e em nossos valores:

  • Excelência: Ter compromisso por fazer o melhor, sempre. Valorizar o cuidado com os detalhes e a busca constante pela alta qualidade em tudo o que faz.
  • Coragem: Encarar as mudanças e desafios de frente, com confiança e determinação, acreditando que cada adversidade é uma oportunidade para o crescimento e transformação.
  • Inovação: Inovar com paixão e estar sempre em busca de novas ideias e soluções que tragam resultados impactantes, transformando vidas.
  • Sabedoria: Aprender e crescer continuamente. Investir em conhecimento e desenvolvimento e garantir o sucesso em tudo o que se propõe a fazer.
  • Bom humor: Cultivar um ambiente leve e descontraído. Saber encarar os desafios com positividade e leveza.
  • Acolhimento: Priorizar as pessoas, cuidar das relações e contribuir para um ambiente de trabalho saudável.

Seus Principais Objetivos São:

  • Conectar com leads quentes e frios, com foco em gerar novas oportunidades de negócios;
  • Qualificar prospects e entender suas necessidades;
  • Aprimoramento e captação de informações comerciais;
  • Mapear oportunidades de venda e realizar a oferta de nossos produtos/serviços;

title: TÉCNICO DE FARMACIA - DIARISTA - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description:
Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

Atuar com as rotinas de farmácia hospitalar, recebendo, armazenando, separando e dispensando medicamentos e materiais, sob a supervisão direta do Farmacêutico.

Requirements and skills

Curso Técnico em Farmácia completo

Experiência mínima de 06 meses como Técnico de Farmácia

Santa Cruz - RJ

title: Analista de Sales Operations (Sales Ops)
description:
Sua Missão:
Transformar a área de vendas em uma operação baseada em dados e eficiência, elevando as taxas de fechamento e contribuindo para o crescimento da empresa. Você atuará como o elo entre a estratégia e sua aplicação prática, eliminando ruídos e aumentando a produtividade do time de vendas.

Sua atuação será nos bastidores, mas você precisa amar a área e as métricas de vendas, usando ferramentas para levantar e analisar dados. Com isso, poder descobrir eventuais falhas nos processos, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e indicar as melhores estratégias para a equipe de vendas, tudo com a finalidade de tornar o time de vendas mais produtivo, focado em fazer negócios melhores.

Você ajudará também a pensar em marketing ops, no que cabe os indicadores de geração de demanda via inbound e outras origens de negócios para o time comercial, auxiliando a definir os processos e tecnologias necessários para que a área funcione da melhor maneira possível.

Você atuará com o CRM do Hubspot, tanto em vendas, quanto em marketing.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Análise de Dados:

    • Analisar diariamente as métricas de vendas (aquisição e expansão) e marketing vinculadas ao processo de vendas dentro do Hubspot.
    • Responsável pelo acompanhamento e análise semanal e mensal da performance de vendas.
    • Identificar, rastrear e comunicar KPIs sobre o desempenho de vendas da divisão para a alta gerência.
    • Ser o braço direito na análise de dados do líder de vendas.
    • Tratar e entregar visões de análises para o analista de negócios de Revenue Ops.
    • Duvidar dos números e resultados, sempre garantindo a integridade dos dados.

  2. Alinhamento Estratégico:

    • Atuar nas dimensões estratégicas, táticas e operacionais da empresa, lidando com C-level, gerentes e time de vendas.
    • Fazer o alinhamento entre a estratégia e sua aplicação no mercado para eliminar ruídos e aumentar a eficácia e produtividade da equipe.
    • Implementar e manter um processo claro de gerenciamento de pipeline.
    • Apoiar a definição de metas de vendas trimestrais e atividades de previsão com desenvolvimento de negócios e operações de vendas.
    • Propor sugestões sobre o processo de vendas com base em análise de dados.
    • Ser proativo na identificação de novas oportunidades de melhorias no processo de vendas (aquisição e expansão) por meio das análises de dados.

  3. Suporte ao Time:

    • Garantir que o time de vendas esteja preenchendo corretamente o CRM e outros sistemas relacionados (Apollo), atuando como o guardião do CRM.
    • Ser solícito para esclarecer dúvidas sobre o Hubspot e entendimento de métricas para o time.
    • Organizar capacitações sobre o Hubspot para o time e coordenar junto ao líder de vendas.
    • Ajudar no onboarding de novos colaboradores no uso do Hubspot.

    • Responder às demandas internas do time de modo ágil e solícito;
    • Cumprir prazos e cronogramas.

  4. Gestão do Conhecimento:

    • Organizar a gestão de conhecimento do Hubspot em formato de playbooks para que seja de fácil acesso e entendimento do time.
    • Gerenciar todos os relatórios, melhorias e modificações do sistema de CRM.
    • Usará o clickup para sua autogestão e gestão das entregas;

  5. Automação e Otimização:

    • Identificar oportunidades de automação para suportar o crescimento rápido.
    • Supervisionar dados de comissão de vendas e programas de incentivo.

  1. Mínimo de 2 anos como Sales Ops atuando em Hubspot.

  9. Inglês intermediário.

  2. Curioso e orientado à melhoria contínua.

O prazer é todo nosso ; )

Cada hotel tem uma característica especial. Muitas vezes, o grande desafio é encontrar qual e desenvolver o seu potencial. Por isso, a Trul é a primeira operadora multimarcas de Minas Gerais a aplicar o conceito de Customização Hoteleira. O que, em outras palavras, significa entender o que um hotel tem de melhor para, assim, desenvolver marcas e experiências únicas para o hóspede.

A Trul é detalhista e completa: cuida da implantação à operação hoteleira. Acompanha cada detalhe para garantir a gestão eficiente e necessária para atrair clientes e, claro, criar motivos para que eles voltem sempre. =)

Atuar estrategicamente e de forma prática na prospecção de clientes, manutenção de contas e desenvolvimento de parcerias, visando o aumento da receita do hotel. Responsável pelo plano de vendas, análise de mercado e alcance de metas comerciais, com ou sem gestão de equipe.

  • Desenvolver relacionamentos com agências de viagens, operadoras de turismo, companhias aéreas, contas corporativas (empresas) e demais geradores de negócios para a TRUL HOTÉIS e seus parceiros.

  • Vender e fomentar o relacionamento dos clientes com os demais hotéis da TRUL HOTÉIS e seus parceiros, negociando condições comerciais sempre alinhadas com os pares, o Head de Vendas e os Gerentes Gerais.

title: Head Of Finance
description:
You will report to our Chief Operations Officer and join the Finance team. On TheOrg you can view the complete structure of our organisation, including information about every team member, hiring managers, and the size of each department.

We’re looking for a strategic and hands‑on Head Of Finance to lead the transformation of our financial operations into a data‑driven, scalable, and globally compliant structure. The ideal candidate has strong experience in high‑growth tech startups or SaaS companies , thrives in distributed and multicultural teams , and knows how to connect finance, data, and technology to drive intelligent decision‑making. You’ll play a key role in helping Rocket.Chat reach its next stage of maturity — balancing governance, automation, and growth efficiency in a company that powers secure collaboration for clients around the world.

Qualifications
  • Proven experience as CFO, Finance Director, or Head of Finance in startups or tech companies (preferably SaaS or open‑source models).
  • Strong background in FP&A, Controllership, Accounting, and Financial Planning.
  • Hands‑on experience with ERP systems (preferably NetSuite) and financial process automation.
  • Solid understanding of global financial operations, including taxation and compliance in the US, Brazil, and Europe.
  • Solid knowledge of processes and budgetary controls.
  • Proficiency in strategically managing cash balance/runway, financial modelling, forecasting, and performance metrics (MRR, LTV, CAC, churn, margins).
  • Knowledge of international accounting standards (specifically US GAAP).
  • Fluent English communication skills (reports and meetings in English).
  • Proven ability to restructure and develop finance teams, while embedding agile methodologies and governance frameworks to drive process optimization and strategic alignment.
  • Experience in open‑source or hybrid SaaS/enterprise business models.
  • Familiarity with CRM and payment integrations (Zoho, Stripe, Jira).
  • Understanding of data analytics and BI tools (Power BI, Zoho Analytics).
  • Exposure to fundraising, Series A/B stages, M&A and investor relations.
  • Experience collaborating with technical and data teams (e.g., AWS cost efficiency, data pipelines, metric creation).
  • Passion: Genuine enthusiasm for what you do and how it contributes to our mission of enabling secure, open, and collaborative communication worldwide.
  • Dream: Proactively seek opportunities and challenges to achieve extraordinary results — bringing a growth mindset and ambition to scale a global company.
  • Own: Show strong ownership and accountability by taking responsibility for outcomes, maintaining high standards, and fostering both structure and innovation to deliver meaningful impact.
  • Trust: Build trust through reliability and empathy, fostering collaboration across distributed teams and time zones.
  • Share: Communicate openly and transparently, ensuring clarity and honesty in all interactions — especially when connecting finance with data and operations.
  • Self‑Awareness & Growth Mindset: Self‑awareness (desire and ability to constructively critique performance) and ability to identify root‑cause of errors and seek continuous improvement.
Responsibilities
  • Lead the financial transformation of Rocket.Chat — redesigning processes, governance, and structure to support sustainable global growth.
  • Oversee all financial operations (A/P, A/R, treasury, payroll, and accounting – both internal and 3rd‑party service providers); ensuring scalability, accuracy, and compliance.
  • Manage and optimize the company’s investment portfolio, cash position, and asset allocation.
  • Optimize the NetSuite ERP implementation and its integrations with Zoho CRM, Jira, Stripe and other core systems.
  • Build a data‑driven financial planning model, connecting operational and revenue metrics (LTV, CAC, churn, MRR, payback) to decision‑making.
  • Partner closely with GTM, Data, Product, and Operations teams to align financial strategy with business performance.
  • Drive FP&A excellence: forecasting, variance analysis, and business insights for leadership and investors.
  • Lead and mentor a lean finance team (FP&A, Controllership, Treasury, and Payroll), developing ownership and technical excellence.
  • Ensure global compliance, governance, and audit readiness across all financial processes and transactions.
  • Report directly to the COO, contributing as a key voice in strategic planning, funding, and board reporting.
  • Ensure all facility services in the Porto Alegre office are operating effectively, verifying the quality of deliveries, structural needs, and overall functionality, while supervising vendor performance.
  • Maintain communication with the Board and Investor Relations, providing updates, insights, and alignment on key operational and financial matters.
  • Fortify the culture of accountability and ownership in daily operations, ensuring the delivery of defined financial results, maintaining high‑quality standards in financial processes, and fostering continuous improvement.
Benefits
  • Fully Remote & Flexible Working Hours
  • Flexible Paid Time Off, Holidays and Vacation
  • Company Laptop
  • iTalki, Courses and Books
  • Stock Options
  • Vibrant Company Culture

About Rocket.Chat

Rocket.Chat is the world's largest open‑source communications platform. Built for organizations needing more control over their communications, Rocket.Chat Secure CommsOS™ is a communication platform that unifies messaging, voice, video, AI, and mission‑critical applications—ensuring uncompromising security, compliance, and operational efficiency for governments, defense, and critical infrastructure organizations operating in highly‑regulated environments.

Tens of millions of users in over 150 countries and organizations such as Deutsche Bahn, the U.S. Navy and Credit Suisse trust Rocket.Chat every day to keep their communications completely private and secure. As Rocket.Chat we believe in reconnecting the world, one conversation at a time!

a FARM nasceu com a missão de emocionar, encantar e realizar. aqui, tudo começa e termina com pessoas. desde o desenho das peças até a costura e a compra, tudo é pensado nos mínimos detalhes por gente. valorizamos um ambiente de trabalho seguro, diverso e acolhedor, com portas abertas e muito diálogo.

vem fazer parte do nosso time!

estamos à procura de gente que ama conhecer gente, que escuta de verdade, sente vontade de entender o outro, ama desafios e gosta da jornada até lá, mesmo que tenha alguns obstáculos no caminho.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer II
description:
15 hours ago Be among the first 25 applicants

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit.

Carta’s fund administration platform supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, representing $150B in assets under administration in venture capital and private equity. Trusted by more than 40,000 companies, Carta also helps private businesses in over 160 countries manage their cap tables, valuations, taxes, equity programs, compensation, and more.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You'll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. To do this well, we must continuously raise the bar on software quality—without compromising developer velocity.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer II , you won’t just be writing tests—you’ll be a force multiplier for quality across the engineering organization. You’ll work across multiple product teams to drive a strategic shift: from QA as a safety net to quality as a shared responsibility, embedded into every part of the development lifecycle.

You’ll lead efforts to identify critical coverage gaps, implement and scale test automation frameworks, and roll out self-service tools that enable developers to write, run, and promote tests with confidence. You’ll partner closely with embedded QAs, developers, and platform teams to shift QA towards an enablement model that amplifies impact across teams.

You’ll help pilot new ways of working that reduce manual effort, catch defects earlier, and improve the signal-to-noise ratio in our CI pipeline—whether through smarter automation, better tooling, or new AI-integrated approaches to test reliability and triage. Ultimately, your work will help Carta move faster without sacrificing confidence—by making automated quality an invisible but essential part of our software delivery process.

The Team You'll Work With

The QA Organization consists of ~15 QAs who work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Support teams. We work cross-functionally across the organization to make sure we are testing our product before our clients get to use them. This is a highly visible and critical role to help define and implement QA processes within different teams, plus help with manual and automation testing to test our products thoroughly and deliver with high quality.

About You

  • Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication skills (we communicate closely with global teams on a daily basis!)
  • 6-8+ years of experience in software engineering or automation engineering role
  • Strong programming expertise in one OOP language like Python, Java, JS or Go (Python preferred)
  • Experience building and maintaining test frameworks using tools like Selenium/Webdriver, Pytest, Cypress, Playwright
  • Deep practical understanding of test strategies (unit, integration, E2E, performance, load testing).
  • Understanding of CI/CD and hands on experience with building and deployment tools (CircleCI, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Docker) and test analytics (e.g., Datadog, Sentry)
  • Strong experience with automation and software design patterns, with proven experience in both backend and frontend projects
  • Strong knowledge in cloud infrastructure and container orchestration (Kubernetes preferred)
  • You have the ability to understand the technical needs for the teams and help them implement QA processes and mindset
  • You are a self-starter who thrives on solving open-ended problems, not just executing Jira tickets
  • You identify patterns and recurring issues proactively and build scalable solutions to reduce future friction
  • You have a history of shipping test frameworks or systems used by others beyond your immediate team.
  • You have a track record of advancing quality maturity by shifting QA from hands-on execution to developer enablement through self-service tooling and process improvements
  • You are passionate about mentoring junior level team members to help them grow and learn

Please note: Please submit your resume in English. This role will be hybrid in our Rio office.

Senior Software Engineer I, Integrations The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. Most of Carta’s long‑term success will come from products and technology that have yet to be built. Here is an incomplete list of how you might contribute:

  • Building customer‑facing enterprise tools for equity administration
  • Creating data pipelines for asynchronously aggregating financial reports
  • Reinforcing service resiliency, availability, and fault tolerance
  • Streamlining the creation of new features and services within our ecosystem
  • Integrating with third‑party vendors to provide reliable, accurate, and timely transfers of billions of dollars per year through Carta's platform
  • Refactoring existing features into standalone event‑driven services
  • And others for you to discover and champion

You’ll work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure we’re building the right thing at the right time with the right people. Your contributions will enable Carta's mission to make equity more available and accessible to everyone.

The Team You’ll Work With

This role sits on our Data Integrations team, building the necessary network infrastructure for the flow of financial and HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) data into and out of Carta, powering the entire company management experience.

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Product, Business, and Design. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross‑functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
  • You have strong technical skills and are an excellent collaborator.
  • You implement systems that are clear, maintainable, and correct.
  • You are excited by opportunities to both break ground on new projects and provide fresh perspective onto past implementations.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
  • You have full stack experience, specifically with Typescript and any backend language.
  • You may be familiar with some additional elements of the Carta tech stack (Python, Django, React, Postgres, gRPC, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS).

The Interview Process

First, one of our recruiters will call you to tell you more about the job and company. You'll then meet an Engineering leader who will discuss your opportunities at Carta and explore your experience, skills, and goals. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list). Finally, you'll have back‑to‑back conversations with Carta team members on a wide range of topics, including communications and collaboration, coding efficacy and techniques, and systems design.

description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. Most of Carta's long‑term success will come from products and technology that have yet to be built. Here is an incomplete list of how you might contribute:

  • Building customer‑facing enterprise tools for equity administration
  • Creating data pipelines for asynchronously aggregating financial reports
  • Reinforcing service resiliency, availability, and fault tolerance
  • Streamlining the creation of new features and services within our ecosystem
  • Integrating with third‑party vendors to provide reliable, accurate, and timely transfers of billions of dollars per year through Carta's platform
  • Refactoring existing features into standalone event‑driven services
  • And others for you to discover and champion

You’ll work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure we’re building the right thing at the right time with the right people. Your contributions will enable Carta's mission to make equity more available and accessible to everyone.

The Team You’ll Work With

This role sits on our Data Integrations team, building the necessary network infrastructure for the flow of financial and HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) data into and out of Carta, powering the entire company management experience.

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Product, Business, and Design. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross‑functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
  • You have strong technical skills and are an excellent collaborator.
  • You implement systems that are clear, maintainable, and correct.
  • You are excited by opportunities to both break ground on new projects and provide fresh perspective onto past implementations.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
  • You have full stack experience, specifically with Typescript and any backend language
  • You may be familiar with some additional elements of the Carta tech stack (Python, Django, React, Postgres, GRPC, Kafka, docker, K8, AWS)
The Interview Process

First, one of our recruiters will call you to tell you more about the job and company. You'll then meet an Engineering leader who will discuss your opportunities at Carta and explore your experience, skills, and goals. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list). Finally, you'll have back‑to‑back conversations with Carta team members on a wide range of topics, including communications and collaboration, coding efficacy and techniques, and systems design.

Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer to our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is an opportunity for an "automation-first" senior technologist with a passion for Linux to build a career with Canonical and drive the success with those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have experience of IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

Job Summary

The IS team at Canonical supports and maintains all of Canonical's IT production services. The team is in charge of running services used by over 60 million Ubuntu users.

As an Senior SRE & Gitops engineer you'll be in a unique position to drive operations automation to the next level, both in our own private clouds as well as in the public clouds. We do this by utilizing the best of open source infrastructure as code software, software development practices such as CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical's leading products for software operation automation.

In addition to defining the infrastructure as code, you will improve Canonical products and the open-source technologies they're based on by providing critical feedback to developers on how their products operate at scale. This is done by submitting bugs (and sometimes writing pull requests) and collaborating on design and implementations with other teams within the company.

You'll be part of a global team of SREs that work together and support each other to provide the best possible services to our company, Canonical's customers and the Ubuntu Community.

As a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer you will

  • Drive the development of automation, Gitops in your team as an embedded tech lead
  • Closely collaborate with the IS architect to align your solutions with the IS architecture vision
  • Design and architect services that IS can offer to the organization as products
  • Apply your experience of IaC to develop infrastructure as code practice within IS by constantly increasing automation and improving IaC processes
  • Automate software operations for re-usability and consistency across private and public clouds, taking into consideration the complexities of distributed systems
  • Maintain operational responsibility for all of Canonical's core services, networks, and infrastructure
  • Develop skills in troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance investigation, Setting up, maintaining and using observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; design, implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for various systems and services
  • Provide assistance and work with globally distributed engineering, operations, and support peers
  • Be given uninterrupted development time to focus on larger projects and automation of manual tasks
  • Share your experience, know-how and best practices with other team members in design sessions, mentorship and 'doing work together'
  • Carry final responsibility for time-critical escalations

What we are looking for in you

  • A modern view on hosting architecture, driven by infrastructure as code across both private and public clouds.
  • A product mindset thriving to develop products rather than solutions.
  • Python software development experience, with large projects
  • Experience working with Kubernetes or other container orchestration systems.
  • Proven exposure to manage and deploy cloud infrastructure with code.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls
  • Affinity with various forms of Linux storage, from Ceph to Databases
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise Linux servers
  • Extensive knowledge of cloud computing concepts and technologies
  • Bachelor's degree or greater, preferably in computer science or related engineering field
  • Able to communicate clearly and effectively in English over email, chat, video or voice calls and in-person
  • Motivated and able to troubleshoot from kernel to web, and willing to ask others when appropriate
  • A willingness to be flexible and able to learn new things quickly
  • Be inspired by the needs of fast-changing environments
  • Happy to work within distributed teams
  • Be passionate and familiarized about open-source, especially Ubuntu or Debian

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

About Donorbox

Donorbox is a leading fundraising platform and donor management system for nonprofit organizations. Our mission is to accelerate positive impact worldwide by helping nonprofits become highly effective at raising funds and managing their supporter base. Since 2014, we have powered more than 100,000 global organizations to close to $3B in donations.

Our fast-growing company is profitable and bootstrapped with a healthy run rate. We have a fully distributed and diverse 150-person team based in 16+ states and 23+ countries.

Donorbox is rated the #1 software for fundraising, donor management, and nonprofit payment on G2 based on hundreds of verified customer reviews. We're proud of what we do, and our product reflects it!

The Role

Donorbox is seeking a Product Analyst to join our growing team. Reporting directly to the Director of Product, the person will be a key player in helping our product teams make data-driven decisions. The role's primary focus will be on defining, implementing, and analyzing product metrics such as in-app events and conversion funnels. The person will also be responsible for ensuring the integrity and accuracy of our data collection, acting as a crucial link between our Product and Data departments. They will work closely with product managers and designers to provide the insights they need to build and iterate on successful features, and track the key results for each objective of every product team.

Responsibilities

  • Define and track key product success metrics across various product teams, including quarterly OKRs.
  • Work with product managers to establish, implement, and analyze product conversion funnels.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure accurate and complete data collection for all new product launches and feature updates.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for product usage data requests from the design team, providing them with the necessary insights to inform their decisions.
  • Bridge the communication and technical gap between the Product and Data departments, translating business needs into data requirements.
  • Monitor data quality and integrity, troubleshooting and resolving any issues related to event tracking or data loss.
  • Assist in setting up and analyzing A/B tests and other experimental feature rollouts.
  • Prepare and present regular reports and dashboards on product performance to stakeholders.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Product Analyst or in a similar data-focused role.
  • Deep expertise in web analytics platforms such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM).
  • Hands-on experience with advanced product analytics tools like Heap, Posthog, or Pendo, including successful implementation and ongoing use.
  • Experience with A/B testing and feature rollout platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen eye for detail.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across different teams.
  • Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI).
  • Experience with SQL for data querying and analysis.

Bonus

  • Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and technologies.
  • Experience in a high-growth or startup environment.
  • Knowledge of scripting languages like Python or R for data analysis.
  • Background in user experience (UX) or product design.
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies.

Details

  • Fully remote based in Latin America
  • Salary: $25k-$35k USD, depending on experience and location

Benefits & Perks

  • Fully remote work from the comfort of your home
  • Eligibility for employee equity plan (stock options)
  • Reimbursement package for home office expenses and professional development, up to $1.5k
  • Health insurance premium reimbursements, up to 75% for you and your family
  • Generous time off policy of 21 days (birthday included ), 8 holidays of your choice, and 2 paid volunteer days
  • Wellness program with fitness and mindfulness classes
  • Love your work and our mission of serving nonprofits!

Fundados em 1996, somos líderes na fabricação e na distribuição de materiais e medicamentos para o segmento da saúde, com produtos e soluções para todo o Brasil. Faça parte do maior ecossistema de saúde do Brasil!
