Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Customer Success - Team Manager.

To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to help our team of Customer Success Managers across regions. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success and an obvious passion for new technologies. Ideally, you have been a Customer Success Manager at one point in your career and naturally evolved to a leading position.

You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you are to provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. You are comfortable dealing with ambiguity and quickly adapt to changes. You seek collaboration with other teams to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility is to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work hand-in-hand with the Head of Customer Success.

CSMs engage a diverse customer base and follow diverse CSM motions to provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer. The right candidate would adapt to this diversity and bring broad experience to the team.

Location: This is a globally remote role

The role entails:

  • Strategic planning and analysis: preparing communication plans, Team Meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive upsells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.
  • Customer interactions and support to your team: you resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention. You work closely with your team members to ensure timely resolution.
  • Team management: you are passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. You are ready for regular performance reviews with team members. While your help in identifying areas for improvement is key, you are asked to celebrate excellence, recognise your team's achievements, and set goals for individual growth within the team.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.
  • Documentation and reporting: you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.

What we are looking for in you

  • Excellent academic results at school and university
  • Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM
  • Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries
  • Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results
  • Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific
  • Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration
  • Experience growing and developing a CSM team
  • Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Nice-to-have skills

  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards

  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. Founded in 2017, we build on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter, employing senior human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack to enhance output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients. Our team has delivered billions of dollars in trackable revenue across e‑commerce, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs, accelerating results through high‑impact digital strategies that unlock revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

The Role

We are hiring a Design Director—a visionary leader with a strong design background, driving high‑quality design execution across various platforms and managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

Responsibilities
  • Lead 1–3 UI/UX engagements, focusing on branded e‑commerce websites.
  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX and clear design approaches.
  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.
  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.
  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback and oversee career development.
  • Ensure high‑quality work output, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise and meeting deadlines.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams—marketers, strategists, developers, and clients—to develop project plans, understand business objectives and address client issues.
  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative; provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.
Qualifications
  • 3–6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e‑commerce companies; at least 1 year of people‑management experience preferred.
  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills—color theory, hierarchy, composition, typography.
  • Self‑motivated, proactive, detail‑oriented with strong sense of ownership.
  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.
  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.
  • Ability to provide constructive internal feedback and guide direct reports.
  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions and execute them effectively.
  • Proficiency in Figma (Auto Layout, Components, Variants) and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator); bonus: familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.
Remote & Compensation

Fully remote role operating in EST time zone, 100% conducted in English. Benefits include flexible parental leave, remote‑first culture, growth opportunities, autonomy with accountability, and a high‑bar performance environment.

Equal Opportunity

Darkroom is an equal‑opportunity workplace—dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics
description:
Senior Manager, Event Logistics

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"). Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Key Responsibilities
  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub‑projects.
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement and customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country.
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with involved government authorities to ensure smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders.
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking within the warehouse and across all venues where assets are provided by Logistics.
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing and delivery.
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities; movements of team luggage and equipment to/from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities.
  • Managing the entry of delivery and collection vehicles into venues during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS).
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including unloading services, determining storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside venues, and provision of FFE.
  • Where required, development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP), and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM).
  • Procurement and management of golf‑cart pool at venues.
  • Development of a dissolution strategy in cooperation with tournament management, legal, procurement and all item‑procurement functional areas.
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking and people resources as required.
  • Managing established contracts (LSP, FFE‑ and golf‑cart provider) and ensuring all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met.
  • Providing the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration‑management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required.
  • Attending site/venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meetings and events where an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g., Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops).
  • Creating and managing the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Creating and managing the Event Logistics project plan, including mitigation and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Recruiting the Logistics team and providing leadership to the team.
  • Preparing and managing a health‑and‑safety plan.
  • Preparing and managing a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project.
  • Providing timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management.
  • Completing the final reconciliation, closing contracts and transferring knowledge post‑tournaments.
Your Profile
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics or event operations for an international event.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and project management processes.
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills.
  • Able to work in a fast‑paced, multi‑level, project‑based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery.
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence.
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

Mid‑Senior level

Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. To do this well, we must continuously raise the bar on software quality—without compromising developer velocity.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer II , you won’t just be writing tests—you’ll be a force multiplier for quality across the engineering organization. You’ll work across multiple product teams to drive a strategic shift: from QA as a safety net to quality as a shared responsibility, embedded into every part of the development lifecycle.

You’ll lead efforts to identify critical coverage gaps, implement and scale test automation frameworks, and roll out self-service tools that enable developers to write, run, and promote tests with confidence. You’ll partner closely with embedded QAs, developers, and platform teams to shift QA towards an enablement model that amplifies impact across teams.

You’ll help pilot new ways of working that reduce manual effort, catch defects earlier, and improve the signal-to-noise ratio in our CI pipeline—whether through smarter automation, better tooling, or new AI-integrated approaches to test reliability and triage. Ultimately, your work will help Carta move faster without sacrificing confidence—by making automated quality an invisible but essential part of our software delivery process.

The Team You'll Work With

The QA Organization consists of ~15 QAs who work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Support teams. We work cross-functionally across the organization to make sure we are testing our product before our clients get to use them. This is a highly visible and critical role to help define and implement QA processes within different teams, plus help with manual and automation testing to test our products thoroughly and deliver with high quality.

  • Strong knowledge in cloud infrastructure and container orchestration (Kubernetes preferred)
  • You have the ability to understand the technical needs for the teams and help them implement QA processes and mindset

  • You have a history of shipping test frameworks or systems used by others beyond your immediate team.

  • You are passionate about mentoring junior level team members to help them grow and learn

  • Desenvolver e monitorar APIs, middlewares (SAP PI/PO, CPI, etc.), conectores e mensagerias (ex: Kafka, RabbitMQ), assegurando o funcionamento contínuo dos fluxos de dados.
  • Estabelecer boas práticas de versionamento, CI/CD, segregação de ambientes, testes automatizados e rollback.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com os times de BASIS, segurança, infraestrutura, desenvolvimento ABAP/Java e fornecedores externos.
  • Apoiar o controle de acesso a serviços de integração, utilizando mecanismos como OAuth2, certificados digitais, SAML, etc.
  • Monitorar, diagnosticar e resolver falhas nos pipelines de integração com foco em resiliência.
  • Documentar fluxos, endpoints, dependências e procedimentos operacionais.

O que é necessário você ter:

  • Ensino superior completo em áreas de TI.
  • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas DevSecOps aplicadas a projetos SAP e/ou integrações corporativas.
  • Conhecimento em SAP PI/PO, SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), API Management, IDoc, RFC/BAPI, ODATA e WebServices.
  • Experiência com integração segura (HTTPS, JWT, certificados, SSO, firewalls).
  • Conhecimento em containers (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes, OpenShift).
  • Experiência com sistemas de mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).
  • Automação de testes e validações em integrações.
  • Conhecimento em monitoramento de logs e métricas (ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, etc.).
  • Familiaridade com ambientes SAP híbridos (cloud/on-premise).
  • Conhecimento prévio de integrações com sistemas de utilities (ex: sistemas de medição, CRM legado, gestão de redes, etc.).
  • Experiência com SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).

O que temos para você:

  • Vale Alimentação;

  • Programa de treinamentos.

Nosso propósito é transformar a sociedade por meio da nossa energia, levando desenvolvimento e bem-estar por onde passamos todos os dias. E fazer parte da vida de milhões de brasileiros, por mais de um século, só reforça a nossa contribuição com o crescimento econômico e social do país.

Somos uma das maiores empresas privadas do setor elétrico brasileiro que atua, por meio de uma cadeia de valor integrada nos processos de geração, transmissão e distribuição de energia para 31 municípios do Rio de Janeiro, além da comercialização de energia para todo o Brasil.

Aqui, os desafios são diários e queremos que os nossos mais de 4 milhões de clientes tenham sempre a melhor experiência de atendimento, com serviços de alta qualidade.

Temos um time diverso de colaboradores campeões, que seguem juntos, colocando em prática o nosso propósito. Gente que sonha grande, quebra barreiras e faz história. Afinal, cuidar da energia que transforma a vida de tanta gente faz parte do nosso DNA!

  • Social Sustainability Values: join oursustainable business practicesfocused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

description:
Coordenador de Planejamento Logístico - Beep Saúde

Buscamos um Coordenador de Planejamento Logístico para liderar a orquestração da nossa operação, garantindo o equilíbrio perfeito entre capacidade, disponibilidade e demanda. Você será responsável por definir as áreas de atendimento, orquestrar a disponibilidade de slots e otimizar a produtividade da equipe, impulsionando a eficiência e a rentabilidade da Beep Saúde.

Responsabilidades
  • Definir e otimizar as áreas de atendimento:
    • Analisar dados geográficos, demográficos e de demanda para definir os limites das áreas de atendimento.
    • Monitorar a performance das áreas, identificando oportunidades de expansão ou reestruturação.
    • Garantir a viabilidade econômica das áreas, otimizando custos e maximizando a receita.
  • Orquestrar a disponibilidade de slots:
    • Planejar e controlar a oferta de slots, garantindo o equilíbrio entre capacidade e demanda.
    • Utilizar modelos preditivos para antecipar variações na demanda e ajustar a disponibilidade de slots.
    • Monitorar a taxa de ocupação e identificar oportunidades para otimizar a alocação de slots.
  • Otimizar a produtividade da equipe:
    • Analisar dados de produtividade das técnicas e identificar oportunidades de melhoria.
    • Implementar estratégias para aumentar a eficiência operacional e reduzir custos.
  • Liderar a gestão de indicadores:
    • Definir e acompanhar os principais KPIs da área de Alocação, como receita por área, custo por área, taxa de ocupação e produtividade.
    • Analisar os dados e gerar insights para a tomada de decisões estratégicas.
    • Apresentar relatórios e recomendações para a alta gestão.
  • Colaborar com outras áreas:
    • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as áreas de Vendas, Operações, RH e Tecnologia para garantir o alinhamento estratégico e a eficiência operacional.
    • Participar de reuniões de S&OP e S&OE para integrar o planejamento de demanda e capacidade.
    • Atuar como ponto focal para questões relacionadas à alocação, fornecendo suporte e orientação para as demais áreas.
Requisitos
  • Experiência comprovada em supply planner ou áreas correlatas, preferencialmente em empresas de rápido crescimento.
  • Sólido conhecimento em modelagem de dados, análise preditiva.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados e gerar insights relevantes.
  • Visão estratégica e capacidade de tomar decisões com base em dados.
  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de influenciar diferentes stakeholders.
  • Perfil analítico, proativo e orientado para resultados.
Diferenciais
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de consulta de dados (SQL).
  • Experiência em uso de ferramentas de IA.
Benefícios
  • Para sua saúde e de seus dependentes – Plano de Saúde e Odontológico | Sulamérica;

title: Data Engineer_ Snowflake
description:
Job Description: Senior Snowflake Data Engineer (Migration & Modelling)

Location: Brazil/ Costa Rica (Remote)

Job Type: Contract / Project-Based (Staff Augmentation)

Note : Need to support PST timings


Project Summary:

We are seeking highly skilled Snowflake Data Engineers to act as augmented members of a client's data team. You will be responsible for the hands-on execution of a complex, end-to-end data platform migration to Snowflake.

This is a hands-on execution role. You will be expected to integrate seamlessly with the existing team and take direct ownership of critical migration and data modelling tasks to accelerate the project's delivery. This is a complex transformation, not a simple "lift-and-shift."


Key Responsibilities:

  • Data Modelling & Architecture:
  • Collaborate with the client's BI and Data Science teams to define data requirements.
  • Design, develop, and implement conceptual, logical, and physical data models (e.g., Dimensional, Star Schema) optimized for Snowflake.
  • Develop and document data models, data definitions, and data flow diagrams for the new environment.
  • Data Migration & Engineering:
  • Execute the hands-on technical migration of data from legacy systems to the Snowflake Data Cloud
  • Engineer, build, and optimize robust ELT/ETL data pipelines within Snowflake (using SnowSQL, Snowpipe, Streams, Tasks, etc.).
  • Implement and automate data quality checks and validation processes to ensure data integrity and accuracy.
  • Team Integration & Delivery:
  • Integrate directly with the client's data team, participating in all relevant project routines and workflows.
  • Take ownership of assigned migration and modeling tasks, delivering high-quality, production-ready code and models with minimal supervision.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to data migration, modeling, and pipeline performance.
  • Create clear technical documentation for all developed assets (models, pipelines, etc.).


Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Expert-level Snowflake: Deep, proven, hands-on experience with the Snowflake platform (architecture, SnowSQL, Snowpipe, performance optimization).
  • Expert-level Data Modeling: 4+ years of dedicated experience in data modeling (Dimensional, Relational) and data warehousing architecture.
  • Proven Data Migration: 4+ years of experience executing complex, large-scale data warehouse migrations (non-lift-and-shift).
  • Strong Data Engineering: Proficiency in building data pipelines (ELT/ETL) using SQL and modern tools (e.g., dbt, Python, or similar).
  • Execution Focus: A proven "do-er" with the ability to integrate into an existing team and deliver on complex technical tasks independently.
  • BI / Analytics Acumen: Strong understanding of how data models are consumed by BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.) and Data Science workloads.

title: Principal Engineer – Guidance & Control (Technical Leader)
description:
Location: On-Site position based in the UAE (Full Relocation Package)


A leading defense company based in the United Arab Emirates is seeking an exceptional Principal Engineer to act as the Technical Leader for Guidance and Control (G&C) systems . This is a strategic, high-impact and hands-on role with an explicit mandate to establish and lead new G&C capabilities, mentor engineers, and drive the future of guided weapon platforms.


The Role: Technical Authority & Capability Builder


As the Principal Engineer for G&C, you will be the technical backbone of the department, reporting directly to the Department Manager. Your responsibilities include:

  • G&C Technical Leadership: Serving as the technical authority over the full G&C lifecycle, including Modeling & Simulation (MIL/SIL/PIL) , Guidance & Control Algorithms , Tracking Systems , and Estimation Filters (EKF/KF) .
  • R&D and Capability Establishment: Leading the investigation of emerging technologies and the implementation of futuristic methodologies. You will be responsible for establishing new G&C infrastructure, tools, and R&D labs .
  • Flight Test Oversight: Managing all phases of flight test campaigns, including pre-flight preparation, test execution, and rigorous post-flight analysis .
  • Mentorship and Team Building: Providing technical guidance and mentoring to engineers across all levels (Junior to Senior), helping to cultivate a high-performing team.


Requirements for Success


  • Experience: 10–15 years of experience in the development of guided weapon systems , missiles, or relevant defense technologies.
  • Leadership: A minimum of 5 years of experience in engineering management and technical leadership roles, with a proven ability to lead teams and establish new capabilities.
  • Expertise: Deep knowledge of the entire Systems Engineering Process (qualification, acceptance, flight testing) and a strong background in flight dynamics, embedded systems, and missile control .
  • Qualifications: A Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.


Ready for Your Next Career Move?


This is a Full-Time Employee (FTE) position requiring a professional who is willing to relocate to Abu Dhabi, UAE . A full relocation package is offered to ensure a smooth transition.


This role offers a clear career path toward Senior Principal Engineer and Chief Engineer , allowing you to directly shape the technological future of defense in the region.

If you are a result-driven technical leader ready to build and innovate in a high-stakes environment, we want to hear from you.


Apply now and help us establish next-generation guidance and control capabilities!

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. title: Staff Frontend Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.

We are feeding the world’s curiosity!

Job Description

The Opportunity

Cint is looking to raise the bar on engineering standards as well as user experiences. We offer a smaller company atmosphere, where engineers can shape technical strategy, lead cross-team initiatives, and set the direction for how we build and deliver products at scale. Our products are redefining experiences within the industry—join us to help define the future of our platform while multiplying the impact of the teams around you.

We are deeply committed to advancing our frontend architecture (Next.js), ensuring alignment with our Design Systems, and collaborating with backend teams to deliver consistent, reliable, and user-friendly experiences across the platform.

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will join our globally distributed team to shape and elevate Cint’s Measurement, Survey Platform, and Design System experiences. Your mission is to craft high-quality, scalable user interfaces that power our core research products delivering intuitive experiences for our customers while also enabling internal teams to move faster with confidence.

You will be a product-oriented and platform UI engineer, taking full ownership of the end-to-user experience. This includes partnering closely with UX designers, product managers, and fellow engineers to understand customer and stakeholder needs for both external user-facing products and internal products like our survey platform and design systems.

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and UX designers to deliver polished, user-centric experiences and support product rollouts.

  • Create scalable and maintainable frontend components, while enhancing and extending our shared Design System.

  • Monitor and optimize application performance, resolving bottlenecks proactively.

  • Lead cross-team technical initiatives, set architectural direction, and ensure alignment on frontend strategy across the organization.

  • Proactively shape engineering practices, propose improvements, and influence standards adopted by multiple teams.

  • Advocate for and document best practices in frontend development.

  • Own and architect systems or product areas end-to-end, designing solutions that scale across multiple teams and business domains.

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships to ensure smooth collaboration and alignment.

  • Write clean, modular, and maintainable code that stands the test of time.

  • Continuously improve and refactor existing codebases for reliability and efficiency.

  • Take responsibility for production systems through on-call rotations, ensuring stability and fast incident resolution.

  • Mentor and sponsor engineers at all levels, building future technical leaders and spreading best practices throughout the company.

  • Anticipate organizational and architectural challenges, define long-term strategies, and drive adoption of solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience across Cint.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time driving cross-team technical initiatives and architectural decisions.

  • Highly proficient in Next.js 14+ (App Router), including expertise in data caching strategies and performance optimization.

  • Demonstrates proficiency in various UI rendering architectures (SSR, CSR, SSG, ISR) and the ability to determine their appropriate application.

  • A proven expertise in designing and implementing robust UI solutions using TypeScript, with a strong focus on applying comprehensive typing throughout the stack to deliver maintainable and highly reliable user experiences.

  • Proficiency in breaking down product documents and abstracts into well-defined feature epics and user stories, driving features from concept to reality promptly.

  • Experience with CSS and Tailwind, and in working with Figma and internal design systems.

  • Track record of building reliable, performant systems and establishing testing and quality practices adopted across teams.

  • Demonstrates strong communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to define and drive technical standards across multiple teams or product lines, aligning stakeholders and ensuring adoption.

  • Experience balancing trade-offs between technical debt, speed, and long-term scalability in a way that advances organizational goals.

Additional Information

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We are caring

More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
About You

You are a back-end engineer passionate about building scalable, reliable, and maintainable applications. You thrive on writing clean code, applying modern architecture patterns, and leveraging cloud-based solutions. You enjoy solving complex challenges, automating infrastructure, and ensuring that systems are secure, performant, and ready to scale. You’re looking for a company where you can keep growing professionally and directly influence technical excellence.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in back-end development using Ruby on Rails.
  • Strong experience with AWS services such as Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, and API Gateway.
  • Hands-on experience using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments.
  • Solid understanding of serverless architectures and AWS Lambda functions.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, and background job frameworks (Sidekiq, Resque).
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies, and proficiency using Jira and Confluence for project tracking.
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Experience with microservices, GoLang, or Node.js for complementary service integration (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Ruby on Rails applications with a focus on scalability and performance.
  • Build and manage AWS infrastructure components using Terraform and DevOps best practices.
  • Implement and maintain serverless solutions leveraging AWS Lambda and related services.
  • Integrate and maintain APIs and external systems, ensuring reliability and data consistency.
  • Refactor legacy components to improve maintainability, performance, and code clarity.
  • Write and maintain automated tests (RSpec, Minitest) to ensure high code quality and coverage.
  • Monitor application performance and proactively address issues or bottlenecks.
  • Collaborate on CI/CD pipelines, ensuring secure, consistent, and efficient deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews, maintaining high-quality development standards.
  • Engage in Agile ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives).
  • Work closely with front-end, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver robust, end-to-end solutions.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S. , serving 3.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus . We’ve raised nearly $400M in funding—including the largest Series A in fintech history —and just closed our Series B to fuel our next stage of hypergrowth.


We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer in LATAM. This position is remote. The candidate will be responsible for managing various areas of our backend platform, including API integrations with 3rd-party vendors and partners.


As a Backend Engineer with our Enterprise Tribe you will play a central role in helping Rain become the #1 platform for financial wellness by focusing on data integration, data ingestion, and payroll processing. You will work with our product and engineering teams to provide financial freedom to over 1 million employees by managing the data ingestion of over 10 million timekeeping records per day. Our ideal candidate is excited to tackle tough technical challenges and looking for opportunities to contribute to our strategic thinking.


Responsibilities:

  • Translate product requirements into robust technical solutions, recommend alternative approaches and lead engineering efforts to meet ambitious targets
  • Design and implement reliable systems and applications in the context of a fully distributed micro-services architecture
  • Build and maintain integrations with 3rd-party vendors and partners
  • Design and implement highly available RESTful APIs supporting user-facing web and mobile applications
  • Focus on creating reusable code and libraries that can be shared across teams, fostering collaboration and ensuring scalability for future projects.
  • Enforce observability best practices, leveraging tools like logging, metrics and alerting systems
  • Create and maintain detailed technical documentation for all solutions, including architecture designs, APIs, workflows, and system configurations.
  • Continuously monitor Rain systems and applications for opportunities to maximize performance and scalability
  • Effective cross-team communication and collaboration to align priorities, clarify requirements, identify dependencies, and ensure seamless coordination throughout the software development lifecycle.


Skills and Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of Software Development experience
  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent combination of technical education and
  • work experience.
  • Proficient knowledge of back-end programming languages such as Go / Golang, Java, Python and C++
  • Strong expertise in designing and developing RESTful APIs
  • Experience with both SQL and NoSQL database technologies and strong understanding of database concepts and internals, including data model design and optimization principles
  • Experience at building reliable and scalable user-facing applications
  • Proficiency in designing and implementing scalable distributed systems and microservices architectures, with a strong ability to meet performance and scalability requirements
  • Excellent collaboration skills, with the capacity to work effectively with cross-functional teams, present ideas, and communicate technical concepts clearly
  • Keep up to date with technologies - AWS/Azure/GCP, serverless, Docker, Kubernetes, ECS among others
  • Strong ability to take ownership of projects, driving initiatives from concept to completion with minimal supervision, while proactively identifying challenges and solutions.
  • Experience working with agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban, to deliver high-quality results in iterative cycles
  • Proficiency in message queuing systems such as Kafka(preferred)/RabbitMQ/Flink.
  • Effective release management experience for ensuring zero downtime and experience with CI/CD frameworks such as Gitlab CI and Github actions

  • Sólido conhecimento em DMS, ECM e integrações de processos PLM.

  • Experiência com ciclos de teste (UT, IT, UAT).
  • Inglês avançado ou superior.

  • Experiência com ferramentas de migração de dados (LTMC, LSMW, SAP Migration Cockpit).
  • Familiaridade com SAP Solution Manager para documentação e testes.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas.
  • Capacidade de atuar em equipes internacionais e multifuncionais.


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?

  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes: Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.

  • Solid understanding of production planning processes , including Make-to-Order (MTO), Make-to-Stock (MTS), and Repetitive Manufacturing .

title: Especialista em Eficiência Energética Pleno
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Levantar dados de campo junto às unidades de negócio (bombas, motores, pressões, vazões, faturas e medições elétricas) e construir baseline energético.
  • Realizar diagnósticos técnicos (ponto de operação vs. BEP, setpoints, perfil de carga, demanda, fator de potência e harmônicos).
  • Modelar soluções e elaborar business cases (VFDs, adequação de motobombas, correção de FP, rebatimento de pressão, geração distribuída fotovoltaica).
  • Elaborar termos de referência e memoriais técnicos, apoiando na equalização técnica de RFPs.
  • Acompanhar implantação e comissionamento das soluções, validando desempenho e resultados pós-projeto.
  • Executar planos de medição e verificação (IPMVP A/B/C/D), manter repositório de evidências e emitir relatórios de economia de energia.
  • Construir dashboards e análises (Excel/Power BI) para acompanhamento de KPIs e rotinas de melhoria contínua.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Mecânica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em eficiência energética/gestão de energia.
  • Domínio de sistemas de bombeamento e acionamentos (VFD/soft-starter), leitura de diagramas elétricos e grandezas de qualidade de energia.
  • Vivência com medidores/analisadores, tarifação e análise de faturas.
  • Conhecimento em M&V (IPMVP) e estatística básica (normalização por clima/produção).
  • Proficiência em Excel.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens recorrentes às unidades de negócio.


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Certificações CMVP, CEM e/ou ISO 50001.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI.
  • Experiência prática em campo com medições e comissionamento energético.


Benefícios

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!


A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +800 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.


Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Masters / PHD In Physics
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.


About the Role:


At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.


We are seeking a Masters / PHD In Physics with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.


Key Responsibilities:


Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing


Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:


  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content


Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills


As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

Desde 2014 na pista, acelerando no segmento de tecnologia com foco em inovação automotiva, somos especialistas no setor e temos como combustível a paixão pela cultura do automóvel. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor e mais segura experiência, tanto para o motorista que busca soluções rápidas após um imprevisto no carro, quanto para as oficinas que encontram na nossa plataforma uma rota certeira para conquistar novos clientes. Nossos pilotos são movidos a inovação e adrenalina. Aqui, ninguém freia diante do comum, e com nosso motor turbo, seguimos todos na mesma pista, acelerando rumo a resultados extraordinários. Estamos aqui para transformar, evoluir e deixar nossa marca na estrada. Acha que criatividade, inovação e mobilidade podem nos levar mais longe? Então, venha fazer parte da nossa viagem – aqui, o único combustível ruim é o da concorrência!



Responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web utilizando tecnologias .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core, Web API).
  • Criar e integrar interfaces responsivas com frameworks modernos como Angular, React ou Vue.js.
  • Participar da análise, arquitetura e design de soluções técnicas escaláveis e seguras.
  • Realizar testes automatizados (unitários e integrados) para garantir a qualidade do código.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (UX/UI, QA, Produto) para entrega de soluções completas.
  • Atuar na manutenção e evolução de sistemas legados, promovendo refatorações quando necessário.
  • Garantir boas práticas de versionamento de código (Git), integração contínua e entrega contínua (CI/CD).
  • Participar de code reviews e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de desenvolvimento.
  • Documentar funcionalidades, APIs e decisões técnicas de forma clara e acessível.



Requisitos:


  • Experiência comprovada com desenvolvimento em .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core) .
  • Conhecimento sólido em JavaScript , HTML5 , CSS3 e frameworks modernos como Angular , React ou Vue.js .
  • Experiência com APIs RESTful , integração de serviços e consumo de dados.
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, PostgreSQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB, Redis).
  • Prática com versionamento utilizando Git .
  • Experiência com Entity Framework Core ou outras ferramentas ORM.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de testes automatizados (unitários, integrados).
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Capacidade de escrever código limpo, reutilizável e bem documentado.
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.


Será um diferencial:


  • Experiência com Azure , AWS ou outro provedor de cloud computing.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e logging (ex: ELK Stack, Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços .
  • Conhecimento em Design Patterns e princípios SOLID.
  • Experiência com CI/CD pipelines utilizando ferramentas como Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions ou GitLab CI.
  • Certificações Microsoft ou outras relacionadas à área de desenvolvimento.

title: Consulting Partner
description:
ERA Group, a global leader in cost management and business optimisation, is looking for an entrepreneurial Partner to join our international network of consultants.

This is not a traditional consultancy role; it’s a chance to run your own practice within a global brand, with the freedom to shape your market, build your team, and grow your client base while backed by ERA’s proven methodologies, tools, and worldwide community.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead cost optimisation, procurement, and performance improvement programmes across industries
  • Build and grow your client portfolio through business development and long-term partnerships
  • Take ownership of your practice’s strategic direction, go-to-market approach, and team leadership
  • Work directly with C-level clients to deliver measurable savings and transformation


What You Bring

  • Extensive consulting or senior leadership experience in cost management, procurement, or performance improvement
  • A strong track record of client acquisition and project delivery
  • Deep expertise in one or more industries such as Pharma/Life Sciences, Energy/Utilities, Manufacturing, Consumer, or Logistics
  • Confidence in engaging with CxO-level stakeholders and leveraging your professional network
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with the ambition to grow a successful consulting practice



This is the ideal next step if you’re seeking less bureaucracy, more independence, and the chance to build something of your own within a global consultancy platform.

title: Senior Rust Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior Rust Software Engineer to deliver high-quality, high-performance systems. You'll be writing Rust-first code to tackle complex systems challenges, acting as a technical leader on client projects, and independently designing robust, scalable, and memory-safe solutions. You will champion best practices and elevate the engineering bar for mission-critical applications:


Must-have skills:

- Expert-level proficiency in the Rust programming language, including a deep understanding of core concepts like the Ownership Model, Borrow Checker, Lifetimes, Traits, and Macros.

- Strong background in systems programming concepts, including multithreading, concurrent programming, and performance-critical application development.

- Extensive experience with asynchronous programming in Rust, particularly using frameworks like Tokio and understanding the nuances of async/await.

- Proven experience designing and implementing highly scalable backend services and distributed systems.

- Proficiency with the Rust toolchain, including Cargo , and strong experience with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD pipelines.

- Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of tackling and resolving complex architectural and coding challenges.


Nice-to-haves:

- Ideal experience working with video processing related projects with real time systems and web containers.

- Ideal experience utilizing webRTC , real time system response, publishing on multiple platforms.


The icing on the Kake:

  • Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.
  • Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.
  • Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.
  • ❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Desenvolvedor IA
description:
Somos uma empresa do Grupo Stefanini. Especializados em marketing digital, utilizamos uma abordagem integrada que combina tecnologia, inteligência de dados, design e profundo conhecimento do comportamento do consumidor. Nosso foco está em potencializar os resultados de nossos parceiros, oferecendo soluções que vão desde consultoria estratégica até a execução e acompanhamento dos projetos. Com um time dedicado e altamente qualificado, a Gauge se destaca por sua capacidade de entender as necessidades específicas de cada cliente e entregar resultados de alta performance.

Com forte presença na América Latina e em expansão nos Estados Unidos, estamos sempre na vanguarda, aplicando as últimas tendências de mercado e mantendo um olhar atento à inovação contínua.


DESENVOLVEDOR IA


Como Desenvolvedor Sr / Especialista de IA “Hands On”, você atuará em parceria com a equipe de desenvolvimento, não apenas liderando, mas também contribuindo ativamente para a codificação e implementação de soluções inovadoras. Sua experiência técnica e sua paixão pela IA serão essenciais para guiar o time na criação de soluções escaláveis e de alto desempenho.



Responsabilidades:


  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar soluções de software utilizando tecnologias de inteligência artificial.
  • Trabalhar com algoritmos e técnicas específicas de IA, incluindo NLP e aprendizado de máquina.
  • Implementar soluções de IA utilizando linguagens de programação como Python, JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js.
  • Utilizar frameworks de IA, como PyTorch, Scikit-Learn e Langchain, para desenvolver soluções escaláveis.
  • Implementar soluções de NLP com ferramentas como NLTK, spaCy e Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Realizar pré-processamento de texto, incluindo tokenização, criação de embeddings e remoção de stop words.
  • Trabalhar com Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Porte (LLMs), como GPT e Llama, aplicando melhores práticas de arquitetura de software.
  • Desenvolver aplicações web utilizando frameworks como FastAPI e React (NextJS).
  • Colaborar na implementação de soluções utilizando MLOps, Docker e Kubernetes para a implantação de modelos de IA.
  • Participar de processos de HAG (Hiper-Agilidade) para garantir entregas rápidas e eficientes.
  • Integrar e otimizar embeddings para melhorar a performance das soluções de IA.
  • Mentorizar e apoiar os membros da equipe, promovendo um ambiente de aprendizado e colaboração.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência com N8N é obrigatória.
  • Experiência com RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e otimização de embeddings.
  • Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de software para aplicações de inteligência artificial.
  • Proficiência em linguagens de programação: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js ou Go.
  • Experiência com frameworks de IA, como PyTorch, Scikit-Learn e Langchain.
  • Conhecimento em bibliotecas de NLP, como NLTK, spaCy e Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Experiência em pré-processamento de texto e implementação de LLMs.
  • Vivência em arquiteturas de software escaláveis e de alto desempenho voltadas para IA.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento web com FastAPI e React (NextJS).
  • Experiência com MLOps, Docker e Kubernetes para implantação de modelos de IA.
  • Habilidade de trabalho em equipe e boa comunicação.

762 Interactive is looking for a Game Designer to join our studio and help bring to life Project Kingpin, an ambitious and fresh take on crime-strategy and management games. We’re searching for someone with strong gameplay instincts, creative systems thinking, and a passion for designing mechanics that are strategic, rewarding, and authentic.   • Balance player rewards, pacing, and progression using data and playtesting.
  • Write and maintain clear design documentation (GDDs, feature briefs, tuning sheets).
  • Collaborate closely with developers, artists, and production to prototype and refine mechanics.

Nice to Have:

  • Knowledge of AI behavior, or mission scripting.

What We Offer:

  • CLT Contract with Benefits (including Health Insurance, Monthly Meal Voucher, & Monthly Internet / Home Office Voucher)  
  • Remote-first culture

title: Analista de Legalização Pleno
description:

Estamos entre as principais construtoras do Brasil no segmento de habitação econômica, atuando com programa Minha Casa Minha Vida, trazendo inovação, eficiência e foco em moradia digna e acessível.


Aqui, você encontra um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado constante, o protagonismo e as relações simples e verdadeiras . Trabalhar na Tenda é viver desafios reais, com impacto direto na vida de milhares de famílias e também na sua própria trajetória.


Acreditamos que a diversidade e a inclusão tornam nosso time mais forte. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas também são destinadas a profissionais com deficiência (PcD), reforçando nosso compromisso com um ambiente plural, respeitoso e colaborativo.


Agora queremos te contar mais sobre a vaga de Analista de Legalização na área de Legalização e como você pode construir o futuro junto com a gente.


#VemPraTenda


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Garantir a emissão das licenças, aprovações e documentos técnicos necessários para a aquisição de terrenos, lançamento dos empreendimentos e execução das obras, baseando-se na legislação urbanística e ambiental vigentes, observando a validade e o cumprimento de restrições, identificando e mitigando os possíveis riscos, a fim de trazer segurança à companhia. Acompanhamento do andamento das obras, com visitas regulares às obras e órgão públicos para garantir a emissão do habite-se e demais aceitações necessárias à entrega do empreendimento.


  • Analisar os terrenos do ponto de vista e fornecer as diretrizes para desenvolvimento dos projetos arquitetônicos.
  • Elaborar pareceres técnicos de Legalização para o projeto, com fins de apresentação em Comitê interno de avaliação do negócio, levantando todos os pontos de atenção e/ou riscos incidentes na área no que diz respeito à legislação urbanística e ambiental vigente e as licenças necessárias/ emitidas.
  • Elaborar e acompanhar cronograma de licenciamento para lançamento do empreendimento, avaliando os desvios entre previsto e realizado e propondo planos de ações para manter o prazo final.
  • Elaborar e acompanhar orçamento de custos da área para cada empreendimento/projeto, avaliando os desvios entre previsto e realizado e possíveis impactos na viabilidade do negócio como um todo.
  • Garantir execução dos serviços de supressão de vegetação antes da data prevista para o início das obras.
  • Participar em Auditorias internas e externas como responsável pela área de Legalização.
  • Subsidiar com informações e documentação técnica-legal dos empreendimentos já entregues para as demais áreas da Companhia que lidam com a pós-entrega (Gerência de Assistência Pós Entrega-GAPE, Relacionamento com Cliente-CRM, Jurídico Contencioso, Ciclo Financeiro etc).
  • Liberar e acompanhar elaboração dos projetos técnicos complementares (EP - Estudo Preliminar) das diversas disciplinas para aprovação dos mesmos, quando necessário, e/ou apresentação dos mesmos em outros processos de licenciamento
  • Articular e participar de reuniões estratégicas com os técnicos dos órgãos públicos.
  • Apresentar o empreendimento para a equipe de Operações que irá executar a obra, apresentando as licenças emitidas e em fase de emissão, levantando os pontos de atenção e auxiliando na emissão de autorizações e aceites necessários à execução e entrega das obras
  • Subsidiar o coordenador com as informações da área de Legalização necessárias à elaboração do BP - Business Plan (Plano de Negócios) anual que define prazos, custos e metas dos Lançamentos da Companhia.

Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ensino superior completo em Arquitetura ou Engenharia Civil;
  • Experiência com licenciamento, regularização e trâmites junto a prefeituras e órgãos públicos;
  • Habilidade em leitura e interpretação de projetos em AutoCad;
  • Bons conhecimentos em Pacote Office, especialmente Excel;
  • Desejável conhecimento em Legislação Urbanística e Ambiental;
  • Diferencial conhecimentos em Programas de Modelagem 3D como BIM, Revit ou Similares ou Cursos Complementares em Legislação Urbanística, Área Ambiental, Imobiliária ou de Incorporação;
  • Disponibilidade para realizar visitas frequentes a obras e prefeituras de diferentes regiões do Rio de Janeiro.

title: Software Engineer Sênior
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


O que você deve ter?


- Domínio em Java (8+) e ecossistema Spring (Boot, Data, Security, Cloud, Batch, MVC);

- Conhecimento em Design Patterns e princípios SOLID;

- Experiência com arquitetura em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP), incluindo uso de serviços como ECS, EKS, Lambda, S3 ou CloudWatch;

- Vivência com mensageria e filas (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, SNS) para integração entre sistemas e processamento assíncrono;

- Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis);

- Prática em CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) e versionamento com Git;

- Experiência com conteinerização e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados (JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers, integração e performance);

- Desejável: conhecimento em NodeJS para integrações leves, APIs RESTful e documentação com Swagger/OpenAPI;

- Experiência com observabilidade e monitoramento (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk) será um diferencial;


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!
